payload.body: Shipped Android stateful sharing service (FR-152, Kotlin parity w/ Swift FR-140). Added raw verbs+types to FrickClient (createInvitation/acceptInvitation/listGrants/revokeGrant; FrickInvitation/FrickGrant/FrickSharingPermission), FrickTransport.delete, and observable FrickSharingService: StateFlow<SharingState> (outgoing/shared-with-me/isLoading/hasLoaded/lastError/pendingAcceptToken) + suspend verbs (refresh/invite/revoke/accept/handleDeepLink/consumePendingAccept) + deep-link parsing with injected scheme (FrickSharingLinkConfig). Additive. Gate green: pnpm typecheck exit 0, :frick:testDebugUnitTest BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
